actors.name: Javier Milei
actors.blurb: Milei continues to dominate news cycles with his aggressive economic reforms and high-profile cabinet changes, including the resignation of Manuel Adorni amid corruption allegations. His government's policies, such as lifting 14 million people out of poverty and celebrating GDP growth, are central to the discourse, alongside his international engagements, including congratulating Keiko Fujimori on her election victory in Peru and hosting a pro-Israel conference in Buenos Aires.

actors.name: Giorgia Meloni
actors.blurb: Meloni remains a dominant figure in European right-wing politics, with her government's policies on education, immigration, and international relations generating significant coverage. Her €420 million investment in a student mobility program and her stance on a potential right-wing Italian president are key topics. Meloni's diplomatic tensions with Donald Trump and her criticism of NATO's Rutte also feature prominently.
